description.sv: Asiens stora designmässa för möbler, inredning och belysning i Shanghai Exhibition Centre. Programmet Design in the City pågår i staden 22 februari–7 mars.
description.en: Asia's major design fair for furniture, interiors and lighting at Shanghai Exhibition Centre. The Design in the City programme runs across the city 22 February–7 March.

source.note: Design Shanghais officiella sida: 4–7 mars 2027, Shanghai Exhibition Centre. Öppettider ungefärliga.
